استعصيت (form X)
# اِسْتَعْصَيْتُ (istaʕṣaytu) /is.taʕ.sˤaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَعْصَى (istaʕṣā)
# اِسْتَعْصَيْتَ (istaʕṣayta) /is.taʕ.sˤaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَعْصَى (istaʕṣā)
# اِسْتَعْصَيْتِ (istaʕṣayti) /is.taʕ.sˤaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَعْصَى (istaʕṣā)
